the critical current density, Jc, of the conductors with the highest Jc0 is reduced by plastic strain in the stabilizer, Cu, but the reduction is less than the reduction in the Jc of the conductors that do not have the highest Jc.
the critical current of the conductor is strongly affected by the strain in the Nb$_3$Sn superconductor.
